entities.name: System Information Block 7
entities.description: System Information Block containing warning message segments for public warning systems.

entities.name: messageIdentifier
entities.description: Identifier for the warning message to distinguish different warning broadcasts.

entities.name: serialNumber
entities.description: Serial number for the warning message to track updates and versions.

entities.name: warningMessageSegment
entities.description: A segment of the complete warning message that needs to be assembled.

entities.name: dataCodingScheme
entities.description: Coding scheme used for the warning message data.

entities.name: Warning Message Assembly Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to assemble complete warning message from received segments and forward to upper layers.

entities.name: SIB7 Reception Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for receiving and processing SIB7 messages containing warning information.

entities.name: Message Identifier or Serial Number Change Condition
entities.description: Condition where either messageIdentifier or serialNumber values are different from current stored values.

entities.name: All Segments Received Condition
entities.description: Condition where all segments of a warning message have been successfully received.

entities.name: Buffer Discard Property
entities.description: Property where UE discards previously buffered warningMessageSegment when identifiers change.

entities.name: Timeout Discard Property
entities.description: Property where UE discards stored segments and identifiers if warning message not assembled within 3 hours.

relations.description: SIB7 reception procedure is guarded by identifier change condition
SIB7 reception procedure is guarded by all segments received condition
Identifier change condition establishes buffer discard property
All segments received condition establishes warning message assembly procedure
Warning message assembly is a step in SIB7 reception procedure
Timeout discard property establishes discarding of stored warning message segments
